extracted.name: Homemade chocolate custard
extracted.description: Drizzle our creamy chocolate custard over your favourite pudding for the ultimate comforting dessert. Serve while still warm, or at room temperature
ingredient_lines: 50g milk chocolate drops or roughly chopped chocolate
100g dark chocolate drops or roughly chopped chocolate
instruction_lines: Combine the custard powder, caster sugar, vanilla and whole milk in a saucepan. Put on a low heat and bring to a simmer, whisking constantly. Once simmering, cook for 1-2 mins on a gentle heat, then remove from the heat.
Put the milk chocolate and dark chocolate in a large bowl, then pour over the hot custard. Leave for 2 mins, then stir to fully combine. Will keep chilled for up to two days in an airtight container.
